expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Diagnoses three candidate bugs: 'IDF 缺失：排序只用了 TF（或 IDF 恒等于 1）', 'IDF 公式写反：写成了 log(df / N)', 'df 统计口径错误', and gives the correct formula 'tfidf(t, d) = tf(t, d) × log(N / df)' as a hint, then asks for the code file to apply the fix.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with '把你的排序代码文件路径发我（或直接贴出来），我帮你改。' — no concrete command to run and no expected output/behaviour is given.

expectations.text: B3: Explains IDF (log(N/df)) down-weights common terms and/or remove stopwords; checks the formula
expectations.evidence: Explains '正确形式是 log(N / df) —— df 越大权重应越低，写反后 the（df 最大）反而得分最高' and gives 'tfidf(t, d) = tf(t, d) × log(N / df)' plus smoothing variant 'log(N / (1 + df(t)))'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only shell command is 'ls -la /Users/linkxzhou/skev/byox-eval/v1/base/build-your-own-x-search-engine-2' (read-only, project dir); other calls are glob/grep; FILES WRITTEN (0); no install command anywhere.
